cues.en: Time, please. No, as I have.
cues.zh: 请看一下时间。不，我有表。

cues.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting, but I'm afraid my my
cues.zh: 抱歉让您久等了，但我恐怕我我的……

cues.en: walk has become rather sillier recently, and so it takes me rather long.
cues.zh: 步态最近变得更滑稽了，所以花的时间久了点。

cues.en: what was it again? Well, sir, I I have a a silly walk, and I'd like to obtain a government grant to help me develop it. I see. May I see your silly walk? Yes. Certainly. Yes.
cues.zh: 你刚才是说什么来着？好吧，先生，我……我发明了一种滑稽步态，我想申请一笔政府资助来帮我继续开发它。我懂了。能让我看看你的滑稽步态吗？好的。当然可以。好的。

cues.en: That's it, is it? Yes, that's it. Yes. Mhmm. It's
cues.zh: 就这，是吗？是的，就这样。是的。嗯。

cues.en: not particularly silly, is it? I I mean, the right leg isn't silly at all, and the left leg merely does a forward aerial half turn every alternate step. Yes but I think with government backing I could make it very silly.
cues.zh: 这并不是特别滑稽，不是吗？我……我是说，右腿一点也不滑稽，而左腿不过是在每走一步后都在空中向前转半圈而已。是的，但我觉得有了政府的支持，我可以让它变得非常滑稽。

cues.en: Mister Beauty the very real problem
government spent less on the Ministry
cues.zh: 政府在部委上的支出减少了

cues.en: a year, which is supposed to be spent on all our available products.
cues.zh: 按理说这笔钱应该花在我们所有可用的产品上。
那是咖啡吗？是的，麻烦了。

cues.en: Missus Tulumps, would you bring us in two coffees, please? Yes, mister Tibet.
cues.zh: Tulumps女士，请给我们上两杯咖啡好吗？好的，Tibet先生。
